label: Bright-line period
context: For residential property sold on or after 1 July 2024, the test looks at whether the bright-line end date is within this long of the bright-line start date. Different periods applied to property sold before that date.

label: Main home exclusion: share of the property and of the period that must be main home use
context: The main home exclusion needs more than this share of the property's area to be used as the main home, and the owner to have lived there as their main home for more than this share of the bright-line period. If either is this or less, the exclusion does not apply.

subject_intro: When profit from selling a residential property is taxable under New Zealand's bright-line test, how the period is counted, and what is excluded.
subject_meta_description: Profit on a residential property sold within {fact:nz_bl_years} of buying is taxable under the bright-line test. See the dates, main home exclusion and older rules.
